title: Hilbert transforms along Lipschitz directions

result.label: Hilbert transforms along Lipschitz directions
result.statement: Proves a uniform strong L 2 bound for the planar Hilbert transform along any Lipschitz unit vector field, at integration lengths bounded by an absolute multiple of its reciprocal Lipschitz constant. The estimate is uniform over inner truncations and yields an L 2 -bounded principal-value operator, establishing Stein's weak-type conjecture at this short scale.
